observation.head: AI activity records
observation.unavailable: Records could not be read. Activity is unknown. You can retry.
observation.disabled: KB is off. Records are not read.
observation.noObservations: No records are attributed to this Vault. This does not establish inactivity or missed notes.
observation.currentlyOff: KB is currently off · Past records
observation.noHookObservations: No hook observations in this period
observation.hookHelp: Pending records have no confirmed output completion. Omitted bodies are counted across completed outputs and may include the same body more than once.
observation.unassignedHead: Some records have no identified Vault
observation.unassignedHelp: These records are excluded from the selected Vault's activity. They include inputs that ended before search, while the Vault was still unknown.
observation.disclosure: Operation records contain no note bodies. Completed output does not guarantee AI receipt or use. Create and update response results may differ from the number of notes actually saved.

noteCountTrend.head: Note count over time
noteCountTrend.chartLabel: Note counts from {{from}} to {{to}}. Days without records are left blank.
noteCountTrend.noObservations: No note counts have been recorded in this period yet.
noteCountTrend.unavailable: Note count history could not be read. Retry to check again.
noteCountTrend.help: The last note count observed on this device each day, excluding deprecated notes. Days without records are left blank.

trend.head: Activity over time
trend.period: Selected vault · Last {{days}} calendar days in local time (today is partial)
trend.noObservations: No operation records for {{client}} in this period. This does not mean the KB was unused.
trend.hookHelp: Search output counts completed outputs from automatic pre-answer searches (hooks).
trend.zeroHelp: 0 means no matching records for that day. It does not establish that the KB was unused.
trend.errorsHelp: Errors include search and processing errors, output failures, and proposal and update errors.
trend.clientsHelp: Claude groups records from Claude Code and Claude Desktop; GPT groups Codex and ChatGPT. All also includes evaluation records.

refresh.stale: Home could not be refreshed. Counts are from the last successful read.
refresh.unavailable: Home could not be loaded. Use Refresh to try again.
refresh.detectionFailed: Note change detection failed. Reads will continue every 15 seconds.
